Hi Amelia —

Thanks again for the quick responses. Were excited to get a short walkthrough of Redwoods inference runtime in front of your infra team. We know the overlap is narrow between Avery (US) and our EU engineering squad, so below are three narrowly scoped options — all ~45 minute slots — with UTC conversions and our suggested host:engineer pairing.

Option A (preferred): 07:30 PT / 10:30 ET / 16:30 CEST
  - Host: Dylan Brooks (Sales) / Eng lead on-call: Karthik Iyer (CEST)
  - Why: Gives EU engineers time to join before local quiet hours; customer sees early-morning demo in PST.

Option B: 06:00 PT / 09:00 ET / 15:00 CEST
  - Host: Dylan + recorded deep-dive after for EU engineers who need to catch up.

Option C (if procurement needs earlier): 08:45 PT / 11:45 ET / 17:45 CEST
  - Risk: pushes EU team toward their late evening (may trigger on-call constraints).

Quick asks: please confirm which option works (A/B/C) and whether you want the recording and a pre-shared 1-page checklist for security/compliance questions (I can attach). Ive attached a small timezone_chart.png and an .ics with the three proposals.

If none of these work, we can rotate hosts (EU engineer presents, Redwood sales co-hosts) but would prefer to keep it under 45 minutes.

Thanks —
